capabilities: Render yearly, monthly grid, monthly list, daily, and 3-day planner views from date-based Markdown notes
Create single-date and range notes with recurrence rules, reminders, colors, and todo state
Drag, resize, and move timed entries and multi-day ranges on a 24-hour timeline
Overlay read-only events from webcal:// or https:// .ics feeds
Define custom fantasy or campaign calendar overlays with Gregorian date values
disambiguation: Not a simple daily-journal plugin; it builds full calendar and timeline planner views over date-based notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full documentation is hosted externally in eight languages rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes only creates single dated notes; it offers no calendar grids or timeline views over date-based notes.
summary: Planner plugin that renders date-based Markdown notes as yearly, monthly, daily, and 3-day views with ranges, recurrence, reminders, and calendar overlays.
